title: Robin L NDE 8083
content: When I was eight years old, I was abducted from the United States and taken to Africa. It was 1977. We landed in Rhodesia during the Bush War and I was soon separated from the man who kidnapped me. I spent the night alone in the bush, and then made my way to a tribe who gave me water, food, and safety. This tribe became my new family. They cared for me as one of their own. They taught me how to sing their songs, and how to plant and harvest. I was even given my own dress. I loved my tribe, especially my Mama Eahton who adopted me as her own. My village was peaceful until a faction of armed guerrillas rode in while shouting and making threats. When the guerrillas entered, an adult quickly hid me. After they left, the men in our tribe began to carry guns. One week after the hostile visit, in a ceremony full of dancing, drums, and celebration, I was given the name Aisha. Aisha, which means 'she is life'. Days later, the guerrillas came near the village again, and shot me as I was playing in the grass. I began to die of blood loss and shock. I crossed over into death and met five beings, one after the other. They led me through my confusion and pain to acceptance, peace, and then to all-encompassing love. During my journey I looked back, to see my Mama Eahton was holding my body and wailing. Though I treasured her and did not want her to be sad, I journeyed onward into the love that was pouring into me like a warm river. I began to hear a song that made me pause in my journey. Mama's wailing had turned to singing. Her calling song reminded me of why I needed to live. I decided to return. I turned around and moved back through the veils that separated us, like a long stream of light from a stained glass window I returned to my body. Now held in my Mama's strong arms, I was ready to be carried back to our village.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Criminal attack. Direct head injury. Life threatening event, but not clinical death It was the Rhodesian Bush War and I was shot. The bullet grazed the top of my head and I began to die of shock and blood loss.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Tunnel | Void | Darkness | Unearthly light | A landscape or city | Hellish imagery | Strong emotional tone | Special knowledge or purpose | Life review | Awareness of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I saw my African mother pull my body up on her lap. She had her hand on my head to stop the bleeding. I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Beyond comparison. I could see all directions and unlimited love within and around me. I knew we are never alone.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When a Jesus-like being put his forehead to mine, he opened me to see that there are living lines of connection like beautiful spider webs glistening in the sun that connect all living beings.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: At first, my vision was limited like a baby. I could not focus and everything was a blur. My vision continued to gain clarity and breadth. I could see great distances and feel connected to what I saw.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: My experience was highly visual. The African woman who adopted me as her own sang to me from earth side and I heard her song calling me home.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I had to go through a dark cave and come out the other side. Only after I viewed my body from above did I then lift off into a tunnel-like place. The walls were a living, kind presence and the veils that closed behind me where like giant leaves covering over the entrance to the secret garden.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain No family, but I 'knew' them in my soul.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The tunnel was ever increasing light, and jellyfish like creatures passed through me to purify me of remaining trauma so I could better receive the love that was up ahead, coming from the Great Heart.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm So many at each stage. There were natural environments and an ancient stone stairwell with landings.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt fear, loss, shame, confusion, resistance, and willfulness. This gave way to acceptance, understanding, love, and gratitude.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others I was eight so I would not say I understood everything. I understood I am both powerful and vulnerable, and that no matter what I had to do in order to survive on earth, I always belong and am loved by the Great, Great Grandmother of us all.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control The past trauma I had repressed and felt shame about. I was confronted with my own repressed screams in the dark cave, but a being of generous guidance was there to help me through it. Once I accepted how I felt, all the screaming became quiet.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life I had the choice to keep going in the tunnel or come back to live my purpose which is to Sing my medicine song to others. My desire to sing turned me around. I regretted my decision as I came back closer to my body but it was too late to turn back.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? My desire to sing turned me around. I regretted my decision as I came back closer to my body but it was too late to turn back. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Secular unaffiliated
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes The more I have written it down the greater my ability to pass it forward in my healing work. I can draw upon it, literally.
elements.What is your religion now?: Buddhist Buddhist with strong relationship to Jesus, Totem Animals, Earth as a living guiding presence, and the Great Heart
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I had shame about being abused so I must be unworthy. Then they speak to me directly in color and sound waves. I can easily understand what they are saying. They give me this message, 'you are made of the same thing we are: goodness. You are from here. We are going to help you purify feelings of being broken so you remember that you are good.'
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes It took years to remember and unpack my experience so it was a growing evolution of gratitude.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin I encountered five beings who all served to help purify me to be able to move to the next level.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes It may be a cultural influence that I am interpreting the being as Jesus. He had a sheepherder staff and was clothed with a long robe. Then he changed forms to show me the form is not important. I was not raised Christian in the least, so I wouldn't expect to see Jesus.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes The two sisters who first greeted me have been there to greet me before

Yes This royal kaleidoscope man shows me his original face. He leans in closer to me and looks me in the eyes with his kind, soft gaze. I feel anticipation growing in me as if I am going to receive a gift beyond anything I have ever known before. He closes his eyes and mine close, because we are linked in a way I have not known before. Behind my closed eyes, I see millions of points of light connected by beautiful living lines. This gigantic living web with a diamond of light at each intersection astounds me. I see the living lines can move and create new connections. When I focus on the completely dynamic web, I see all of life is gracefully linked together like a million swallows flying as one great bird.
Yes The Great, all-encompassing Heart, of which we can be a direct expression of through free will choose willfulness. God definitely exists.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I am an empath. The beings on the other side gave me the gift to see people deeply. I see their internal anatomy, their life events, their gifts, and their suffering.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes From my upcoming book about the moment of remembering my purpose
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Uncertain I don't know what you mean by 'life'. Does my soul go on? Yes, of course.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Greatly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Yes I grow tendrils that reach out and touch the long delicate tendrils creatures, and the living walls of this tunnel. I have the ability to connect with every living thing around me. It is curiosity, not effort, which connects me to other living things.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I learned about my abuse history and that I would still have to fight hard to survive when I came back.

elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life I came back to survive another decade of abuse so my answers are relevant to the fact that I was not safe until I left home at age 19.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It has more dimensions than we experience here on earth.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I have been working on my book for over seven years and have devoted myself to the practice of remembering as many details as possible. I have unpacked the experience through writing and drawing.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I am an empath. I hear Sprit talk to me. I Sing the Medicine Song and I hear inside people. I am a Visionary Artist.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: As I focus on him, I can see his outer form and inside of him. In his chest, at heart level, is the most beautiful magic bowl. I turn my body to be directly in front of him. The longer I look at this bowl and what it carries, the wider the bowl becomes. It is filled and overflowing with something magical that moves like water in a circular motion. The motion goes clockwise, the direction of a record on a record player. What overflows from the bowl does not drop down to the ground like water would; it keeps the same circular motion and gets wider and wider until it is well beyond his body.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I had to continue to live through the Rhodesian war, so survival overtook everything.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Because it opened me to whom I am and my entire view of life, I have 13 of the 14 after effects listed by PMH Atwater
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes When I have hugged other NDErs, sometimes I can feel 'home'
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have been working on my book and my art to share my experience for over 7 years. I encourage everyone who has had a strong STE to write it down to open it up further or have someone interview you for the details.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: It was very good: Just more options on referring to the Divine.
